objective: Characterize Add Noise color, monochrome, and luminance-only mode responses on matched neutral, saturated, and near-boundary color patches, focusing on luminance drift, chroma/saturation change, hue rotation, and clipping.

scope.effect: Artifact::AddNoiseEffect CPU equation and numerically equivalent resident generic equation, modeled from the CPU source formulas.
scope.method: NumPy equation mirror on local synthetic opaque color patches at two resolutions, with four fixed seeds.

comparison.baseline: Amount=0 on the same float32 patch chart. No input is a quality ground truth.
comparison.ground_truth: None. Source equation determines the model; colorimetric metrics are descriptive in direct linear numeric RGB only.
comparison.acceptance: No aesthetic or perceptual pass/fail threshold. State mode-specific luminance/chroma response and bounded-domain clipping, without claiming display color accuracy.

materials.fixture: Synthetic opaque 4x3 patch chart: five neutral grays, RGB and CMY saturated patches, and selected near-gamut boundary colors; fixed local geometry and 4px gutters.
materials.regions: Each named flat color patch; only patch interiors are measured, excluding gutters.
materials.identity: Record SHA-256 of source, interface, plan, script, metrics, and emitted previews.

conditions.format: Float32 BGRA storage, logical RGB values in [0,1], alpha=1; no transfer conversion, exposure, or display transform.
conditions.mode_parameters: Rec.601 luma weights match source code (.299R + .587G + .114B). Opponent chroma uses Cb=B-Y and Cr=R-Y; saturation proxy is max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B). Hue rotation is circular delta of atan2(Cr,Cb), calculated only for source chroma magnitude >=.05.
metrics: per-patch RGB mean/std and exact/near-bound clipping fractions
conditions.display: Direct clipped RGB8 previews and same-scale contact sheet; raw float metrics are authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Check mode precedence, numeric seed, hash salts, luma weights, RGB clamp and alpha pass-through source markers.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Deterministic formula model; no compiled parity claim.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect patch contact sheet plus fixed saturated/boundary crops at 1:1 and enlarged display.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: Report hue/chroma shifts and color clipping; no quality ranking or aesthetic approval.

color_and_alpha.method: Evaluate direct RGB and Rec.601 luma/chroma proxies on opaque bounded patches.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Actual transfer function, viewer transform, HDR/negative domain, alpha association and rendered output.

temporal_stability.method: Hash has no frame/time coordinate under stable seed/controls.
temporal_stability.unverified: Actual playback sequence and parameter automation.

render_paths_and_resolution.method: Run same patch layout and parameters at 512x256 and 1024x512.
render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Actual LOD scaling, preview/final, CPU/GPU/backend dispatch.

performance.reason: No product timing or memory measurement.

execution.backend: Python 3, NumPy, OpenCV, Pillow; local synthetic assets only.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed 4 seeds, modes, amounts, sizes and resolutions; record versions, hashes, parameters, metric checksum and preview checksums.
